captions.detailed: A matte dark grey countertop cash register consisting of a broad rectangular base, a wedge-shaped main body, a front-sliding cash drawer, and a rear customer-facing display. The display is mounted on a short vertical neck with a horizontal cylindrical support arm extending to the side. The cash drawer slides forward prismatically from the lower base, while the customer display tilts on a horizontal revolute joint at the top of its neck.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a countertop cash register. It should feature a broad rectangular base with a front-sliding drawer, an upper wedge-shaped keyboard/control body, and a rear vertical neck supporting a tilting customer display screen. The drawer must slide forward prismatically and the screen must tilt on a horizontal revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a box primitive and subtract a front cavity to house the drawer. Model the drawer as a slightly smaller box that fits into this cavity, defining a prismatic joint along the Y-axis. Build the wedge-shaped body using a loft or chamfered box on top of the base. For the customer display, extrude a vertical neck at the rear, attach a horizontal cylinder for the hinge, and model the rectangular screen as a separate part connected by a revolute joint along the X-axis.
